summary: Jonathan Yarborough, 49, went hiking and had not returned or contacted family in several days; reported missing to the Chaffee County Sheriff's Office on September 28; an aerial search located his body just below Mt. Ouray, just inside Saguache County, on September 30; the Chaffee County Sheriff's Office Search and Rescue team handled the recovery with Division of Fire Prevention and Control air support.
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office Search and Rescue (DFPC air support)
notes: Date is the body-recovery date (Friday 2022-09-30); reported missing Sept 28, 2022. Body located just inside Saguache County during a Chaffee County aerial search; recovery by Chaffee County SO SAR with DFPC air support. Found via the MVJ advanced-search live-browser check. Inserted run 1016 (Monte Vista Journal chunk).
